focus_areas: Surface texture realism of cast iron (seasoning vs. AI noise)
Edge sharpness and boundary integrity between pan and background
Geometric consistency of the wire rack (straightness and perspective)

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interior texture of the pans. Real cast iron has a specific micro-texture; AI often generates a uniform 'sand-like' noise. Check if the wire rack bars maintain consistent thickness and straightness, as AI often warps thin linear structures. Verify that the reflections on the pan rims match the direction of the light source implied by the highlights on the rack.
